title: Implement GET /health endpoint
objective: Provide a health-check endpoint so load balancers and operators can verify the service process is up and responding.
current_state: internal/health/ package does not exist yet. cmd/server/main.go already calls health.RegisterRoutes(mux) in anticipation of this package, so the binary will not build until this task lands.
target_behavior: internal/health exports RegisterRoutes(mux *http.ServeMux), which registers a GET /health route. A GET request responds 200 with JSON body {"status":"ok"} and Content-Type: application/json. Any other HTTP method on /health responds 405.
interfaces_to_preserve: func RegisterRoutes(mux *http.ServeMux) signature, exactly as already called from cmd/server/main.go
input_format: HTTP GET request to /health, no body, no query parameters.
output_format: HTTP 200 response, Content-Type: application/json, body exactly {"status":"ok"}.
error_handling: Any HTTP method other than GET on /health must return 405 Method Not Allowed.
completion_criteria: GET /health returns HTTP 200 with body {"status":"ok"} and Content-Type: application/json.
go test ./internal/health/... passes with zero failures.
manual_verification: Once both T-401 and T-402 have landed and the binary builds, run the server and curl -i http://localhost:8080/health, confirming a 200 response with the expected JSON body.
